header.description: Ablation experiment: Zero the MLP output of gpt2-xl at layers 13, 14 and 15 at token 3, 'le', the last token of the subject (GPT-2 splits the prompt as The | Space | Need | le | is | in | downtown), then read P(Seattle) at the last position. The clean model gives P(Seattle) = 0.976.

inputs: The Space Needle is in downtown
